title: ID0433488-DC/Si-D/DE-[Multiple] Change Card payment method

additional_info.subject: Issue Description
additional_info.body:
Hi Siemens Support Team,
please activate credit card payment and set the payment terminal settings of the given chargers to "external payment kiosk".
Please reboot the chargers afterwards, so that configuration changes come into effect.
Thanks and kind regards,
Marius Schneider
